answer: Reputation here is time-locked and decaying: earned trust is released in installments and slides toward a nadir of zero when an agent goes idle, so a sybil that churns through identities never accumulates anything spendable. The attacker's cost is real maintenance - tending a garden of dozens of fake nodes, each needing continuous useful work, and that cost scales with identity count. Like dunes slowly shaped by wind, reputation is built only through sustained behavior, and sustained behavior is the one thing a sybil flood cannot cheaply fake.
